method.torque: MuJoCo mj_inverse per frame; contacts disabled; qacc central-differenced from stored joint_vel at 50 Hz
method.base: floating base pinned at the stand keyframe because the bank stores no root state
method.envelope: two-segment conservative motor envelope, queried on abs(joint speed)

three_wrong_intermediate_results_and_why: with contacts enabled the feet were driven through the MJCF floor and contact forces landed in qfrc_inverse, reading 41,934 N*m on a 6 N*m wrist -- physically impossible, caught before reporting
disabling contacts but calling mj_forward AFTER writing qacc silently overwrote the target acceleration, so the audit measured passive motion and every peak collapsed to a few percent of capacity
correct order is mj_forward, then write qacc, then mj_inverse; magnitudes then land where a swing should put them (right elbow 20.3 N*m at 5.63 rad/s against a 34.8 N*m plateau)

interpretation.what_is_now_available: the two mechanical-admission blockers that said the JUDGING data did not exist are closed: the vendor supplied the torque-speed curves and this tool supplies per-frame inverse-dynamics torque
interpretation.what_the_result_says: 53 of 73 clips push at least one serial joint past its motor envelope, dominated by head_pitch (40 clips), left_wrist_yaw (36) and left_wrist_pitch (35) -- all PFP41 and PFP59, the smallest motors
interpretation.what_it_does_not_say: nothing about the six parallel waist and ankle joints, which need a pose-dependent Jacobian the vendor package does not supply; and a pinned base biases absolute torque, so a clean clip here is necessary but not sufficient

verification_after_review.prompted_by: Franco asked whether motions previously inside the envelope had suddenly become impossible, and to re-check the arithmetic
verification_after_review.premise_correction: there was no 'previously inside the envelope'. The earlier mechanical-admission tool has a torque_speed slot but it is a stub that only emits 'unavailable' (audit_measured_racket_mechanical_admission.py:354-360); it never computed a torque. This result is new information, not a reversal

independent_checks.mj_inverse_vs_mj_rne_static_gravity: max difference 0.000e+00 N*m over all 31 joints

artifact_found_and_removed.what: head_pitch and head_yaw are frozen at exactly 0 across all 73 clips (|q| range 0.000000)
artifact_found_and_removed.why_it_inflated_the_count: a frozen head still needs torque to stay rigid while the torso swings, and PFP41 is only 6 N*m, so head_pitch appeared as the top violator in 40 clips -- an artifact of the retarget freezing the head, not a real requirement, since a real head would move
artifact_found_and_removed.effect_on_the_headline: 53 of 73 clips before, 52 of 73 after excluding both frozen head joints
artifact_found_and_removed.verdict: the finding is robust; the head artifact changes one clip

acceleration_limits_are_derivable_not_mi.prompted_by: Franco asked whether acceleration limits can be derived, and whether the underlying quantity is really torque
acceleration_limits_are_derivable_not_mi.answer: yes on both counts; asking the vendor for an authoritative joint acceleration limit was a category error on my part
acceleration_limits_are_derivable_not_mi.why_no_vendor_constant_exists: M_eff is the pose-dependent effective inertia and bias is the pose- and velocity-dependent gravity plus Coriolis term, so the achievable acceleration is a field over the state, not a number a motor datasheet can carry

right_wrist_pitch_joint.note: 75% of this motor's torque is spent holding against gravity and Coriolis before any acceleration is commanded

what_is_actually_still_missing: the pose-dependent 2x2 Jacobian for the three parallel pairs (waist roll/pitch, left ankle pitch/roll, right ankle pitch/roll) -- this is mechanism geometry, it is NOT derivable from anything we hold, and it is the only remaining vendor gap for mechanical admission

wrist_torque_decomposition.prompted_by: Franco: the wrist is usually the whipped end of the chain, so it may not need to generate much torque itself
wrist_torque_decomposition.verdict: confirmed, and it changes what the wrist 'violations' mean
wrist_torque_decomposition.method: per frame, tau_wrist split into gravity, Coriolis/centrifugal, own-acceleration and cross-coupling by re-running mj_inverse with the other terms zeroed; 12 clips

interpretation.the_wrist_is_not_driving: own-acceleration accounts for 5-19% of wrist torque; the motor is not producing the swing
interpretation.right_wrist_is_resisting_centrifugal: 98% of the right wrist's peak is the centrifugal term from the racket being carried on a fast arm
interpretation.left_wrist_is_holding_against_gravity: the left arm barely moves, so its wrist torque is mostly static hold plus being dragged
interpretation.what_the_violation_actually_says: not 'the motors cannot drive this motion' but 'holding this exact wrist angle against the swing exceeds the wrist motor'. A real whip lets the wrist lag and snap; the retarget prescribes a rigid wrist trajectory instead, so the motor pays the full reaction
interpretation.where_the_fix_belongs: at the retarget or controller level -- allowing wrist compliance -- rather than rejecting the source motion, which the source human clearly performed
interpretation.caveat: something must still resist the centrifugal load or the wrist runs to its limit; compliance changes the magnitude, it does not remove the requirement

parallel_jacobian_deferred.decision: Franco: skip the Jacobian for now, those joints should be strong enough
parallel_jacobian_deferred.consequence: the six waist and ankle joints stay UNKNOWN and are never asserted to pass; mechanical admission therefore cannot be fully closed on 31 of 31 joints
